hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on and its account-page code path divides by zero, so every request that evaluated the flag as 'on' failed. Errors jumped from ~1% baseline to 31-34% exactly as the flag rolled from off to a partial (143 off / 57 on) and then full 'on' state at 21:30-21:31.
supporting_evidence: 2026-09-02T21:30:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
2026-09-02T21:31:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 31% over the last minute
Pre-21:30 log lines all read "monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations" with only sporadic UpstreamTimeout errors at 0-2%

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: a pre-existing upstream payment-authorization fault (the UpstreamTimeout errors present throughout, and the basis of the reported 20:19 onset) worsened. This is weak - those timeouts stayed at 0-2% and the step change is entirely ZeroDivisionError coincident with the flag flip, and no deploy or other change was recorded in the 18:00-21:36 window.
